reason: No dash cam we already link is at or under $50 through our link. The cheapest is the DDPAI N5 Pro at $157.52 in the 2026-11-21 table. The only way to get an in-budget row we can link is a new awin:ddpai record: MINIPRO 2K at $39.00, MINIPRO 2K + Hardwire Kit at $49.00, or N2 Front at $49.00 (partner read of 2026-11-21). I could not source any spec for those models from DDPAI. store.ddpai.com returned HTTP 429 to storecheck and to WebFetch on 2026-11-21, including a scripted retry that waited 90 s, longer than the 60 s Retry-After. ph.ddpai.com also returned 429. www.ddpai.com/dash-cams/n2-dual and www.ddpai.com/?p=3222 loaded only navigation, www.ddpai.com/dash-cams/n2 returned 404, au.ddpai.com failed with a self-signed certificate, and web.archive.org could not be fetched. The MINI Pro's resolution also conflicts: DDPAI's page title says '1296P' while the US store calls it 'MINIPRO 2K'. Without resolution, power backup, card limit, or what the bundled kit enables, the DDPAI record would have empty or unsourced cells and could not be shown to win any segment. The rival pick has no buyable price I could source either. The 70mai M310 2K is sold out on 70mai.store at $31.99 (storecheck, 2026-11-21). The Amazon search returned nothing (Amazon wall). The M310 Plus 4K is $59.99 on 70mai.store, which is over the line. Plan for a rerun: use angle C. Open store.ddpai.com/products/mini-pro-2k-dashcam and /products/n2-2k-dash-cam for the pixel count and frame rate, sensor, supercapacitor or battery, card limit, and what the Hardwire Kit variant enables. Read a live amazon.com price for the 70mai M310. Already sourced for that page: 70mai.store's 'Hardwire Kit with USB Type-C Port' (UP03/UP04/UP05 listing) is from $27.99 and in stock (storecheck search, 2026-11-21), and 70mai's M310 page says 'The 70mai Hardwire Kit UP03 is required for all parking surveillance functions, sold separately.' Storecheck returned one price for the whole listing, so which variant carries $27.99 is not confirmed.
why_angle: The rival pages read (Auto Roamer, Guidespot, the DashCamTalk tracker) mention no DDPAI model and none says what each under-$50 package includes. The $49 DDPAI N2 is the front-only N2 Front; the front-and-rear N2 Dual is $89.00. DDPAI's MINIPRO 2K + Hardwire Kit at $49.00 is the only camera-plus-parking-kit package at or under $50 in the partner tables. The 70mai M310 needs a separately sold hardwire kit. Dash & Drive could not be opened, so it was not checked.
